about_the_game:
BURN. SURVIVE. CALL THE CROWS 

You're the Caller of the Crows, and you've landed with a flame thrower in a cornfield which is guarded by something much worse than old farm props. Scarecrows. Real ones. They don’t just stand around. They watch. They chase. And they don’t stop. Claim the cornfield and let your crows enjoy the sweet corns.

🌽 CLASSIC MODE – The original nightmare

Find and burn every scarecrow prop in the maze. But with each one you torch; the main scarecrow wakes up and starts hunting. Can you finish the job before it finds you?

👁️ ECHO MODE – They’re invisible. But not silent.

The scarecrow can’t be seen in this mode. Instead, you have your trusty friend a crow who cries lower when it’s nearby. You need to burn all the props… without getting caught. Easy, right?

⚔️ FIGHTBACK MODE – You’re not helpless this time

Rescue your crows and they’ll help by stunning the scarecrow with a deafening cry. When it's stunned, attack fast or pay the price when it recovers.

🛠️ CUSTOME MODE – Your rules, your nightmare

Set up your own level. Choose what you face, how often, and how hard. Whether you want a casual run or pure hell, it’s up to you.

🔥 EVERYTHING BURNS

Corn, props, scarecrows, almost everything can catch fire. But be careful. The more you burn, the more they come. Fire keeps you alive, but it also brings them closer.

🌽 NEW MAZE EVERY TIME

Each run is different. The mazes change. The threats shift. Some nights you’ll feel lucky. Others, you’ll barely make it out.

🐦‍⬛ CROWS ARE WAITING

Your crows are scared. But if you can clear the fields, they’ll come. Every scarecrow you burn is a step closer to freedom for them, and maybe for you.

-- CAN YOU BURN YOUR WAY OUT? --

The fields call for fire. The crows' hunger. And the scarecrows… they are waiting.

-->  CALLER OF THE CROWS  <--

short_description: A horror survival game where you roam cornfields with a flamethrower, burning scarecrows to claim the land for your crows. Set everything on fire, stay one step ahead, and clear the way so your crows can enjoy the sweet corn. The scarecrows: guardians of the field, won’t go down easy. 🔥
